cases.name: send_tied_by_echo
cases.description: A sent message stays as one bubble until the line the node tied to its client_msg_id arrives, then shows once.

source.rule: Matching pending messages: an item with client_msg_id collapses the pending message with that id

append.text: Tickets are booked for Sunday at 10:00.

items.text: Tickets are booked for Sunday at 10:00.

messages.text: Tickets are booked for Sunday at 10:00.

cases.name: send_tied_by_words_without_echo
cases.description: A transcript line without client_msg_id (an older node) still takes the bubble by its words, once.

source.rule: Items without client_msg_id are matched by text as before

append.text: Added rain jackets to the list.

items.text: Added rain jackets to the list.

messages.text: Added rain jackets to the list.
Added rain jackets to the list.

cases.name: send_accepted_transcript_late
cases.description: A message the hub accepted stays on screen while the transcript takes 40 seconds to write it, even when other lines arrive meanwhile.

source.rule: Never missing: a bubble the hub accepted may only go when its transcript copy shows
source.found: Reading the web chat page: its own sending bubbles go 30 seconds after sending at the next change of the transcript, whether or not the copy came

cases.name: send_answer_cut_then_receipt
cases.description: The hub typed the message but its answer was lost; the retry with the same op id gets the receipt, and the message shows once.

source.rule: Operation receipts: a repeated write replays the original answer without executing again

cases.name: send_refused_draft_resend_new_op
cases.description: A message refused because the computer's input box had text is shown failed; sending it again uses a new op id and it goes through once.

source.rule: A refused id's receipt answers its repeats, so the apps send a refused message again under a new id

body.error: The computer's input box has text in it

append.text: Museum on Saturday, hike on Sunday.

items.text: Museum on Saturday, hike on Sunday.

messages.text: Museum on Saturday, hike on Sunday.

cases.name: send_failed_stays_above_later
cases.description: A message that failed keeps its place above a message sent after it and that message's answer.

source.rule: A failed message stays where it was sent
source.found: A past iOS bug drew failed messages below later ones

body.error: A dialog on the computer holds the keyboard
body.dialog: Do you trust the files in this folder?

send.text: And a backup plan for rain.

items.text: And a backup plan for rain.

And a backup plan for rain.

cases.name: send_unknown_then_transcript_has_it
cases.description: A send cut off while typing (delivered unknown) is never typed again; when the transcript turns out to have it, it shows once.

source.rule: delivered unknown: resending the same id only returns the same error, never typing it a second time

body.error: The connection to the computer broke while typing
The connection to the computer broke while typing

cases.name: start_answer_cut_then_receipt
cases.description: The first message of a new conversation started it, but the answer was lost; the retry with the same op id gets the receipt, so one conversation opens and the message shows once, even though the session list already had it.

source.rule: Operation receipts: a repeated write replays the original answer without executing again; the start of an assistant conversation is one (assistant_start)

cases.name: start_refused_then_resent_new_op
cases.description: A first message the hub refused stays on the new-conversation page as failed, its words kept; sent again, it goes with a new op id (the old one's receipt holds the refusal) and starts one conversation.

source.rule: A failed send stays where it was sent with Retry and Delete, the composer empty (#1122 option A); a refused write's receipt answers its op id with the refusal

body.error: The assistant's launcher is not installed on its computer.
